questions.question: You’re waiting in line at the café, and the person in front of you drops their bag. What would be the most polite way to respond?
options: I’m sorry, I didn’t see you there!
Watch out, you’ll break your bag!
You’re lucky it didn’t hit the floor.
This is your fault; you should have held it better.
questions.answer: I’m sorry, I didn’t see you there!

questions.question: Your friend suggests going to the cinema tonight but you prefer to stay in. Which response best expresses your opinion while offering an alternative?
options: No, I’d rather go to the park instead.
I don’t like going to the cinema—it’s too crowded.
Sure, let’s go, but maybe next time we can try something else.
I don’t think it’s a good idea; we should stay at home.
questions.answer: No, I’d rather go to the park instead.

questions.question: Your colleague asks if you’d like to help with the presentation. How would you politely decline while still being considerate?
options: No, I’ve got too much to do already.
I’d love to, but I’m already committed to another task.
I don’t think I can—maybe someone else could?
You’re too kind; I don’t want to take up your time.
questions.answer: I’d love to, but I’m already committed to another task.

questions.question: Someone asks you if you’ve read the new novel by your favourite author. How would you respond if you haven’t yet but are planning to?
options: No, I haven’t read it yet, but I’m going to soon!
I’ve read it already—it was terrible.
I don’t like novels; I prefer books about science.
I haven’t read it yet, but I’ll look it up online.
questions.answer: No, I haven’t read it yet, but I’m going to soon!

questions.question: In a formal meeting, someone suggests that the project deadline should be extended. How would you respond if you agree but want to add a condition?
options: That’s a good idea—we should definitely extend it.
I think it’s a bad idea; we need to stick to the original plan.
I agree, but we must also allocate more resources to avoid delays.
You’re wrong; we should finish on time.
questions.answer: I agree, but we must also allocate more resources to avoid delays.
